name: Rebecca

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T0.5 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Electro Pistols Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collab Hybrid, a free 'second Mortefi' who buffs Heavy Attack DPS (best with Lucy, but works with Jiyan/Augusta/Phoebe/Galbrena too). Toggles between Huntress (CRIT DMG) and Guts (DEF Ignore) modes; uses the Hack mechanic (Tune Rupture variant).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Huntress (3 hits) / Basic Attack - Guts (3 hits).
skills.resonanceSkill: It's Big Boomin' Time! / Come 'n' Get Me! - switches stance while attacking.
skills.forte: Gloves Are Comin' Off! - governs Switch Gears mode toggle, Fervor (Forte Heavy Attack resource), and Hot Hand (A Girl Gets What She Wants! dual-mode buff).
skills.liberation: Party 'til Dawn! - Mk. 31 HMG channel dealing sustained Electro DMG, ends in BOOM! Fireworks! AoE burst.
skills.intro: My Turn! (Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! / Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!) - Electro strike, switches stance.
skills.outro: Preem Choom - summons an attacking turret for 14s + 15% All DMG / up to 35% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification to next character.

bestWeapons: The Last Dance / Spectral Trigger / Lux & Umbra (87.9%)
echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (100%, best generalist - 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)
Pact of Neonlight Leap (Lucy team specific)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Yangyang: Xuanling is the highest Heavy Attack DPS in the game, making this Rebecca's best pairing.

teams.name: Edgerunners Team
teams.notes: Free, works well together via the Hack mechanic; Mornye emphasizes Off-Tune Buildup, Shorekeeper better for Whimpering Wastes.

teams.name: Alternative Heavy Attack Teams
teams.notes: Functions as a solid free alternative to Mortefi for any Heavy Attack DPS.

rotation: Opener: Intro: Huntress -> Guts Basic 1-3 -> Skill (switch to Huntress) -> Huntress Basic 1,2 (cancel via Heavy) -> Forte Heavy: Huntress (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> BOOM! Fireworks (auto, swap) -> Outro. Loop: Intro -> Guts Basic 1-3 -> Skill -> Forte Heavy (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Fireworks (swap) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: doesn't need her signature to perform, easy Perfect-Dodge-friendly gameplay, and free - a strong second Mortefi for Heavy Attack teams, though her rotation runs noticeably longer than most secondary buffers.
